units: <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 10a:1">Ab. Zar. 10ᵃ</cite> <he>ספרא ד׳</he> an accurate scribe (paying attention to exact historical dates).—Pl. <cite ref="D00336"><he>דַּוְקָנֵי</he></cite>, <cite ref="D00213"><he>דַּוְו׳</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Menachot 29b:6">Men. 29ᵇ</cite> <he>ספרי ד׳</he> careful copyists of the Bible.
<cite ref="Yevamot 43a:10">Yeb. 43ᵃ</cite> <he>משום דמסיימי בה ד׳ זו וכ׳</he> because exact scholars report a traditional addition (to the Halachah in question), ‘These are the words of R. S.’
